name: manual_c44a4a
claim: For Exa MCP on OpenClaw machines, configure Codex as a stdio MCP pointing at orama-system/scripts/exa/exa-mcp-wrapper.sh, not as the bare https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp URL. The wrapper resolves EXA_API_KEY from OpenClaw config or macOS Keychain, shares one exa-mcp-daemon with Claude/orama-system/Perpetua-Tools/Codex, and exposes web_search_exa plus web_fetch_exa after a new Codex session loads MCP.

decisions.notes: Codex's remote HTTP Exa entry had no bearer token env var and could not use the existing OpenClaw secret path. The local wrapper smoke-tested successfully as exa-search-server and returned web_search_exa/web_fetch_exa.
